memory.identification: Electron renderer PID existed as an idle spare, then its RSS grew when isolated IAB tab 2 was created. Loading/range work ran during sampling. Closing only that test tab caused this PID to disappear, while the spare renderer and other app processes remained. Browser/renderer role independently checked in ps command line; PID start ticks verified by observer.
memory.scope: Whole isolated page renderer process, including same-process JS/DOM/worker allocations. Other browser/GPU/network processes excluded. Not incremental trace memory or total browser footprint. Sampling may miss shorter spikes. VmHWM may be reset and is not used to replace observed RSS maximum.
